name: Riverside service lanes, walks and courts
_readme: Ground-only authored corridors at OSM locations. No parcel-wide fills, pools, or replacement of outer-ring buildings. Closed service loops are split into two open corridors so masking footprints do not enclose buildings. All elevations are <= 0.025 m. Every corridor is polygon-clipped to exclude all OSM building and carport footprints.

sources.dimensions: OSM width where present; otherwise configurable 5.5 m service lane / 1.5 m path. Court paint proportions are schematic within the surveyed outline.
sources.clipping: Ground corridor clipped against every OSM building/carport footprint; any resulting holes are split so the replacement footprint never encloses a building.
